                Local AI Brain · Claude CLI & Codex CLI
                
Local Deep AI Analysis & Brain Engine

              

              Checking local CLIs…
            

            
When running locally on http://127.0.0.1:4747, Outlier Lab plugs directly into your installed Claude Code CLI or Codex CLI (using your existing login — zero extra API billing) to run true LLM beat-by-beat breakdowns, Founder Persona rewrites, and 4-step script generation. Upgraded breakdowns are cached into data/ and publish live to outlier.aisimple.co.

            

              

                
                
                
              

              
              
            

          


          

            Zero-Friction Local Setup · 2 Minutes · Zero Cloud Accounts Required
            
Run Outlier Lab on any Mac or Linux machine in one command.

            
No database, no Docker, no Clerk, no Vercel, and no AI API keys required to start breaking down videos, building your Character profile, checking hooks, and writing scripts.

            
git clone https://github.com/Vibe-Marketer/outlier-lab.git
cd outlier-lab
./setup.sh

            

              
Step 1 · IncludedInstant Local App
Creates starter config.json, builds the AI Simple studio, and opens http://127.0.0.1:4747 automatically.

              
Step 2 · OptionalAuto-Scrape Creators
Paste a free Apify token in Admin only when you want automated 28-day Instagram scrapes.

              
Step 3 · OptionalBulk Transcripts
Add a TokScript key in .env only if you want bulk spoken transcription across 400+ reels.

            

          


          

            Optional "Go Live" Publishing · Never Required
            
Turn on live web hosting only if & when you want it.

            
Everything works 100% locally first. Each "Go Live" capability below is completely optional and independent.

            

              

                
1. Publish Live to Vercel (e.g. outlier.aisimple.co)Optional

                
Push static dashboard + thumbnails + 3s clips to Vercel Hobby (free). Never exposes local admin or .env secrets.

                
vercel --prod

              

              

                
2. Team Login / Clerk ProtectionOptional

                
Skip completely for local use. For hosted team access, set CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY & CLERK_SECRET_KEY in Vercel env vars and edit ALLOWED_EMAILS in auth.js.

              

              

                
3. Auto-Refresh Cron (GitHub Actions)Optional

                
Defaults to manual so you never get surprise bills. Enable daily/weekly cloud refreshes anytime in Admin → Refresh Schedule.

              

              

                
4. Portable Workspace Backup & ShareReady Now

                
Export your Workspaces, Founder Persona & Brain Profiles, Shortlisted Ideas, Projects, Saved Hooks, and Scripts as one JSON file — or import someone else's setup in 2 seconds.
